_comment: T34 one-panel benchmark key (R1). Dated before any implementation commit. Lists the 14 CLI read features the sidebar view must surface, and the failure-case expectations. m26.mjs and apps/vscode/test/panel.test.ts are scored against this key; per R2 this file is not edited by the implementer after this commit.

m26b_target.metric: refresh p95 on cursor move / editor switch, 3 runs

failure_cases.setup: a workspace with a TypeScript file but no .mole directory and no .git repository
failure_cases.expect: every one of the 8 view sections renders exactly one line telling the user what to do (e.g. 'run `mole reindex` to start' / 'not a git repository'); zero exceptions printed to the Mole output channel

failure_cases.setup: one data source (e.g. @mole/decisions) throws for the current file
failure_cases.expect: only that source's section shows an error/unavailable line; the other 7 sections still render their real data
